svg.aria-label: Turnaround times for the same requests before and after the November 2026 improvements: a deep research report from 58 to 30 minutes, a slide deck from 55 to 7 minutes, a theme analysis from 30 to 7 minutes, a current-events question from 35 minutes to 14 seconds, and a chat reply from 12 to 3 seconds.
